title: S04 — Project context diagram
body:
# S04 — Project context diagram

## Context

The registry sits at the centre of the platform: every caller (console, agents, CLI) resolves
actions from it.

## Affected organisation

The delivery team, the programme manager and the consumers of the served spec.

## Affected systems

The action registry, the HTTP API, the MCP endpoint, the admin CLI and the external ingest — one
declaration, five surfaces.
